headline: Exchange Net Inflow Falls To 212.3 Million Dollars As Binance Sheds 168.7 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, is a 212.3 million dollar net inflow, 0.0783 percent of custodied value, compared with a 456.1 million dollar net inflow at 0.1687 percent on the prior print. Binance showed a 168.7 million dollar outflow and Bitfinex showed a 109.8 million dollar outflow, compared with 89.5 million dollars on the prior print, while Bybit took in 74.0 million dollars, down from 131.6 million, and Deribit took in 58.8 million dollars. A positive net means dollars arrived where holders can sell, and a negative print means dollars left that venue.
author: jordan
